context: Bee swarm plot of 500 synthetic companies by annual revenue ($100K–$1B) colored by sector, with an interactive toggle between log, linear, and symlog scales, plus a summary box plot.
first_impression: A well-crafted educational visualization that uses log scale correctly for right-skewed revenue data and is transparent about how scale choice shapes perception.
what_works: Domain is data-driven via d3.extent; circles use a fixed uniform radius (no lie factor); key function d => d.id ensures object constancy on scale switches; colorblind-safe Tol palette throughout.
what_doesnt: Box plot stats (Q1, median, Q3) are computed once from raw data and never recalculate if data changes — a subset-relation robustness gap; the synthetic data clamp (1e5–1e9) is baked into generation rather than derived from the scale, which would cause domain mismatch if unclamped data were swapped in.
